f3_program: observe(at("intu.external_auditor.total_fees_paid", "2019"), 1690, "£000", cell("Total fees paid to auditor", "2019"))
observe(at("intu.external_auditor.total_fees_paid", "2018"), 1104, "£000", cell("Total fees paid to auditor", "2018"))
query("percentage_change", at("intu.external_auditor.total_fees_paid", "2018"), at("intu.external_auditor.total_fees_paid", "2019"))
collection("cynthia.harvested_potatoes", "potato", "cynthia", source("Cynthia harvested 67 potatoes from her garden"))
transfer("harvest", "cynthia", "cynthia.garden", at("cynthia.harvested_potatoes.count", "current"), 67, source("Cynthia harvested 67 potatoes from her garden"))
remove("cut_into_wedges", "cynthia", at("cynthia.harvested_potatoes.count", "current"), 13, source("she cut 13 of them into wedges"))
product_relation(at("cynthia.potato_wedges.count", "current"), event_field("cut_into_wedges", "quantity"), 8, source("one potato can be cut into 8 wedges"))

fraction_of(at("cynthia.harvested_potatoes.for_french_fries.count", "current"), at("cynthia.harvested_potatoes.count", "current"), 1, 2, source("She then halved the remaining potatoes and made french fries with one half"))

fraction_of(at("cynthia.harvested_potatoes.for_potato_chips.count", "current"), at("cynthia.harvested_potatoes.count", "current"), 1, 2, source("She then halved the remaining potatoes and made french fries with one half, and potato chips with the other half"))

product_relation(at("cynthia.potato_chips.count", "current"), at("cynthia.harvested_potatoes.for_potato_chips.count", "current"), 20, source("one potato can be cut into 8 wedges or make 20 potato chips"))
query("difference", at("cynthia.potato_wedges.count", "current"), at("cynthia.potato_chips.count", "current"))
observe(at("tim.running_days_per_week", "initial"), 3, "run_day_per_week", source("run 3 times a week"))
add("schedule_increase", "tim", at("tim.running_days_per_week", "now"), 2, source("add an extra 2 days a week"))
rate_relation(at("tim.running.morning_duration_per_week", "now"), 1, at("tim.running_days_per_week", "now"), source("She runs 1 hour in the morning and 1 in the evening every day she runs"))
rate_relation(at("tim.running.evening_duration_per_week", "now"), 1, at("tim.running_days_per_week", "now"), source("She runs 1 hour in the morning and 1 in the evening every day she runs"))
query("value", at("tim.running.total_duration_per_week", "now"))
assumptions: The pronoun "She" is resolved to Tim, the only named runner.

f3_program: observe(at("john.sneakers.price", "purchase"), 200, "USD", source("sneakers that cost $200"))
observe(at("john.sports_outfit.price", "purchase"), 250, "USD", source("a sports outfit that cost $250"))
observe(at("john.purchases.total_cost", "purchase"), 750, "USD", source("He spent a total of $750 for all those items"))

sum_relation(at("john.purchases.total_cost", "purchase"), at("john.tennis_racket.price", "purchase"), at("john.sneakers.price", "purchase"), at("john.sports_outfit.price", "purchase"), source("He spent a total of $750 for all those items"))
query("value", at("john.tennis_racket.price", "purchase"))
observe(at("napoleon.jelly_beans.count", "current"), 17, "count", source("Napoleon has 17 jelly beans"))
offset(at("sedrich.jelly_beans.count", "current"), at("napoleon.jelly_beans.count", "current"), 4, "count", source("Sedrich has 4 more jelly beans than Napoleon"))

sum_relation(at("napoleon_sedrich.jelly_beans.sum", "current"), at("napoleon.jelly_beans.count", "current"), at("sedrich.jelly_beans.count", "current"), source("the sum of Napoleon and Sedrich's jelly beans"))
multiple(at("napoleon_sedrich.jelly_beans.twice_sum", "current"), at("napoleon_sedrich.jelly_beans.sum", "current"), 2, source("twice the sum of Napoleon and Sedrich's jelly beans"))
multiple(at("mikey.jelly_beans.four_times_count", "current"), at("mikey.jelly_beans.count", "current"), 4, source("4 times the number of jelly beans that Mikey has"))

same(at("napoleon_sedrich.jelly_beans.twice_sum", "current"), at("mikey.jelly_beans.four_times_count", "current"), source("twice the sum of Napoleon and Sedrich's jelly beans is 4 times the number of jelly beans that Mikey has"))
query("value", at("mikey.jelly_beans.count", "current"))
